shared_elements: shallow relief carving/curvilinear outline on a stone surface (possible in A)
justification: B presents a dense, organised program of recognisable figures \u2014 quadrupeds in profile with open jaws, birds, a snake-like sinuous form and a horizontal band of repeated rectangular signs stacked in registers \u2014 while A shows boulders bearing at most a faint curved relief outline with no identifiable creature, object or motif. The only possible correspondence is the generic notion of a shallow relief line worked on rock, which no shared iconographic tradition can be inferred from.
